The fixed-point closure and mechanical stability must be one operation. The current implementation sums all candidate contacts around one proton per donor; resolve that operand binding rather than assuming it. Do not introduce arbitrary angle slots, distance gates, fitted force weights or reference structure coordinates. Return explicit geometric or matrix relations wherever the domain action requires them. The boundary is the contact-map composition and its return into the containing whole-chain folding operator.
